title: Project Stakeholder Management Processes and Engagement

questions.question: Stakeholder management borrows heavily from which two project management areas?
options: Communications Management and Human Resource Management
questions.answer: Communications Management and Human Resource Management

questions.question: The primary goal of stakeholder management is for project managers to maintain an active dialogue with stakeholders to address concerns early and resolve issues.
Measuring project success involves meeting the triple constraint (scope, time, cost). Which of the following is ALSO a key measure of project success?
options: Achieving the projected Return on Investment (ROI)
Completing the project without a stakeholder register
Ensuring the project stays entirely within the Initiating phase
questions.answer: Achieving the projected Return on Investment (ROI)

questions.question: Which stakeholder management process occurs during the Initiating phase of the project lifecycle?
Developing strategies to effectively engage stakeholders based on their needs is the core action of which process?
Which process group does 'Managing Stakeholder Engagement' belong to?
Controlling Stakeholder Engagement involves monitoring relationships and adjusting engagement strategies as needed, and it occurs during the Monitoring & Controlling phase.
Which of the following is considered an INTERNAL stakeholder?
Which of the following is considered an EXTERNAL stakeholder?
Internal customers and project team members are both classified as external stakeholders.
What is the main deliverable or output of the Identifying Stakeholders process?
In a Stakeholder Register, a stakeholder's name, title, department, and contact details fall under which category?
Major requirements, main expectations, potential influence, and phase of highest interest are documented in the Stakeholder Register as:
Stakeholder Classification can involve categorizing a stakeholder as supporter, neutral, or resister, as well as by their power and interest.
A stakeholder who is aware of the project but opposes it due to feared negative outcomes is classified as:
A stakeholder who is aware of the project and actively pushing to ensure its success is classified as:
A 'Neutral' stakeholder is completely unaware of the project and its potential impact.
The primary purpose of Planning Stakeholder Management is to create a plan that maps out:
options: Only the financial budget for stakeholder meetings
Current versus desired engagement levels of stakeholders
How to eliminate resistant stakeholders from the company
questions.answer: Current versus desired engagement levels of stakeholders

questions.question: Which of the following is a key component included in the Stakeholder Management Plan?
options: Communication requirements (who needs what info, format, and frequency)
The project's final approved budget limits
questions.answer: Communication requirements (who needs what info, format, and frequency)

questions.question: The Stakeholder Management Plan must always be highly formal; it can never be an informal document.
Direct communication, active listening, open dialogue, and resolving conflicts before they escalate are core tasks of:
Which of the following represents the 'Core Truth' of Controlling Stakeholder Engagement?
options: You can control stakeholders, but you cannot control their engagement.
You cannot control stakeholders, but you can control their level of engagement.
Stakeholder engagement requires a one-way command structure.
Once an engagement strategy is set, it should never be adjusted.
questions.answer: You cannot control stakeholders, but you can control their level of engagement.

questions.question: Controlling Stakeholder Engagement involves continuously monitoring relationships, measuring sentiment, and tweaking engagement strategies.
